title: Data-Driven Heuristic-Guided Business Process Redesign
abstract: arXiv:2611.19623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Business process redesign (BPR) has a long-standing catalog of best-practice redesign heuristics, yet, applying them remains a mostly manual task that requires extensive domain knowledge. Despite recent advances using Large Language Models (LLMs) for conversational process model redesign, limitations remain. For example, redesign is user-driven instead of data-driven and is not guided by best practices such as the redesign heuristics. Moreover, only one change can be handled at a time. To address these limitations, given an event log and a BPMN model, we present the DH-BPR framework to realize data-driven heuristic-guided BPR using LLMs. To design DH-BPR, we first conducted an analysis of which redesign heuristics can be automatically detected and applied given information contained in an event log such as the fraction of cases that bypass an activity. translated_title: 数据驱动的启发式引导业务流程再造
translated_abstract: 业务流程再造（BPR）拥有一套长期积累的最佳实践再造启发式方法目录，然而，应用这些方法仍然是一项主要依赖人工的任务，需要大量的领域知识。尽管最近在使用大语言模型（LLM）进行对话式流程模型再造方面取得了进展，但仍存在局限。例如，再造是由用户驱动而非数据驱动的，且不受最佳实践（如再造启发式方法）的引导。此外，一次只能处理一个变更。为了解决这些局限，在给定事件日志和BPMN模型的前提下，我们提出了DH-BPR框架，利用大语言模型实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程再造。在设计DH-BPR时，我们首先分析了哪些再造启发式方法可以基于事件日志中包含的信息（例如绕过某个活动的案例比例）被自动检测和应用。基于此，DH-BPR通过相结合的方式对启发式候选进行检测和验证。
tldr: 提出了DH-BPR框架，利用大语言模型结合事件日志中的数据信息，自动检测并应用最佳实践再造启发式方法，从而实现数据驱动、启发式引导的业务流程再造。
en_tdlr: We propose the DH-BPR framework, which leverages LLMs together with data from event logs to automatically detect and apply best-practice redesign heuristics, enabling data-driven and heuristic-guided business process redesign.
